derived_semantics.ACCEPTED: accepted work that has not been started
derived_semantics.NO_RESULT: terminal work with one exact NO_RESULT terminal record
derived_semantics.NO_RESULT_NOT_ABSENCE: NO_RESULT is an explicit terminal assertion and is distinct from a missing terminal record
derived_semantics.NO_RESULT_NOT_FAILURE: NO_RESULT records terminal absence of result material and does not by itself classify failure cause
derived_semantics.RESULT: terminal work with one exact RESULT terminal record
derived_semantics.RESULT_NOT_SUCCESS: RESULT records produced result material and does not imply correctness, acceptance or success
derived_semantics.RUNNING: started work with no terminal record

invariants.text: Every started work identity is already accepted.
Every RESULT work identity is already started.
Every NO_RESULT work identity is already started.
No work identity is both RESULT and NO_RESULT.
Accepted work metadata is immutable after first admission.
Terminal work metadata is unique and immutable.
Absence of a terminal record never implies NO_RESULT.
Terminal work cannot be started, completed again or reopened.
Conflicting reuse of an existing work identity is rejected; retry uses fresh identity.
Worker state transitions create no Authority or effect permission and do not themselves create a Seed Resolution.
Worker lifecycle transitions are required to preserve the pinned Seed projection; mechanical Seed refinement remains an open assurance gate in this bootstrap.

defines: exclusive terminal RESULT and NO_RESULT states

requirements.text: Implementations MUST recognize only the lifecycle UNREGISTERED -> ACCEPTED -> RUNNING -> (RESULT XOR NO_RESULT) for one work identity.
ACCEPT_WORK MUST bind a fresh work identity to an exact Worker identity, exact target Context binding, exact bounded work specification, exact inputs and exact execution constraints.
Accepted work metadata MUST be immutable after first admission; exact replay MAY be idempotent and conflicting identifier reuse MUST be rejected.
START_WORK MUST apply only to exact ACCEPTED work and MUST NOT restart RUNNING or terminal work.
A terminal record MUST be admitted only for exact RUNNING work and MUST bind the exact accepted-work digest.
RESULT and NO_RESULT MUST be mutually exclusive terminal alternatives for one work identity.
NO_RESULT MUST be represented by an explicit exact terminal record and MUST NOT be inferred from absence of a result record.
RESULT and NO_RESULT terminal records MUST be immutable; terminal work MUST NOT return to ACCEPTED or RUNNING.
A retry MUST use a fresh work identity; when a retry relation is declared it MUST bind the exact predecessor terminal record.
Worker capability, acceptance, execution, result and evidence MUST NOT create Authority, Seed Resolution, recognized Context mutation or external effect permission by implication.
No human, AI model, runtime, tool, solver, robot, provider or other Worker implementation has normative precedence.

semantic_objects.terminal_record: Exact immutable terminal record of kind RESULT or NO_RESULT.
semantic_objects.work_binding: Exact immutable identity and bindings registered by ACCEPT_WORK.
semantic_objects.worker_binding: Opaque exact identity of the productive source. Worker type and implementation are non-normative.
